result.topic_en: Euler collects the simple vibration modes of an elastic rod into a general solution (Scholion §42), then begins case VI, a rod clamped at both ends, stating the problem and the boundary conditions y = 0 and dy/ds = 0 at each end.
result.transcription:
) 146 (
Scholion.
§. 42. Vt iam omnes plane motus ex inuentis ſimplicibus concinne repraeſentemus; pro formula irrationali $\sqrt{2(e^{2\omega}+e^{-2\omega})}$ ſcribamus characterem $\Omega$, cui pro variis valoribus $\omega, \omega', \omega'', \omega'''$ etc. tribuamus valores $\Omega, \Omega', \Omega'', \Omega'''$ etc. et ſcribendo, vt hactenus, $u$ loco $\frac{s}{a}$, aequatio generalis erit:
$y = C\,\text{ſin.}\,(\zeta + \frac{\omega\omega c\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}t)\,(e^{\omega} - e^{-\omega} \mp \Omega\,\text{ſin.}\,u\,\omega)$
$+ C'\,\text{ſin.}\,(\zeta' + \frac{\omega'\omega'\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}t)\,(e^{\omega'} - e^{-\omega'} \mp \Omega'\,\text{ſin.}\,u\,\omega')$
$+ C''\,\text{ſin.}\,(\zeta'' + \frac{\omega''\omega''\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}t)\,(e^{\omega''} - e^{-\omega''} \mp \Omega''\,\text{ſin.}\,u\,\omega'')$
$+ C'''\,\text{ſin.}\,(\zeta''' + \frac{\omega'''\omega'''\sqrt{2gb}}{aa}t)\,(e^{\omega'''} - e^{-\omega'''} \mp \Omega'''\,\text{ſin.}\,u\,\omega''')$
etc. etc.
vbi ſignum ſuperius valet pro angulis $\omega, \omega', \omega''$ etc. quorum ſinus et coſinus ſunt poſitiui, inferius autem vbi ſunt negatiui.

Euolutio caſus VI.
quo virgae elaſticae vterque terminus firmiter quaſi muro eſt infixus.

Problema.
§. 43. Si virgae elaſticae vterque terminus firmiter fuerit infixus, inueſtigare motus, quibus ea contremiſcere poteſt.

Solutio.
Hoc igitur caſu pro vtroque termino debet eſſe tam $y = 0$ quam $(\frac{dy}{ds}) = 0$; pro priore termino ergo habebi-

items.english: If both ends of an elastic rod are firmly fixed, to investigate the motions with which it can vibrate.

items.english: Where the upper sign holds for the angles ω, ω', ω'' etc. whose sines and cosines are positive, and the lower sign where they are negative.
